narrative.overview:
A concise shopping interface: real food photography, clear prices and available stock. Emerald carries navigation and shopping feedback; amber marks the main shopping action. Short Vietnamese labels replace promotional paragraphs.

This records the redesigned homepage, shared public header/footer, shared catalog primitives used by the product list (/products) and search (/search), product details (/products/:slug), cart (/cart), the shared form on both checkout routes, payment result (/payment-result), public tracking (/track-order) and personal orders (/my-orders and /account/orders). Checkout includes COD success and the online-created-order outcome with payment-link retry; payment result continues this system with distinct unconfirmed, authentication, pending, verified and retryable error states. Personal orders preserve both protected aliases. Authentication (/login, /register, /forgot-password and /reset-password) and account profile (/account/profile) now extend the same system with focused forms and truthful read-only owned information. Chat and admin interiors remain future work. Global legacy tokens remain intact: root primary is Emerald-500, while these surfaces use its existing darker Emerald-700 token for readable controls and prices.
keyCharacteristics: Flat white surfaces and fine borders

rules.name: The Content First Rule
rules.body: Use photographs, prices and stock to explain the offer; avoid long promotional sections.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Shared product cards use a fine border without decorative shadows.

dos: Do preserve FoodDelivery, emerald/amber and Inter.
Do show real catalog data and explicit loading, error, empty and unavailable states.
Do keep mobile search and support accessible without covering purchasing controls.
donts: Don't replace API failures with purchasable sample products.
Don't add unsupported ratings, certifications or delivery promises.
Don't extend the shared shopping styling to remaining legacy interiors without reviewing them.
